_: Name, description and badge live in src/resources/connectors.json so the console and the browser process cannot disagree about them.

notes: Scopes must also be declared on the app in monday's Developer Center; requesting one that is not declared there fails at consent.
boards:write is not requested. A board an agent can write to is a board a wrong column mapping can overwrite.
monday is GraphQL-only on a single endpoint, and the API version is sent as a header rather than in the path.

rate_limits.note: Complexity budget per minute rather than a request count. A query asking for every column of every item will exhaust it in one call.
